records.title: 10-K
records.text: The rise in revenues was partly offset by increased railway operating expenses, driven by higher fuel prices, other inflationary pressures, service-related costs, increased labor-related costs primarily resulting from labor union negotiations, and higher claims-related expenses.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Additionally, lower volumes contributed to the decline in revenues.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our available borrowing capacity was $400 million at December 31, 2023 and $300 million at December 31, 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: As a result of the Incident, we incurred $1.1 billion of expenses primarily related to our environmental cleanup and remediation efforts at and around the site, related legal proceedings, and other Incident-related costs.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities, our principal source of liquidity, was $3.2 billion in 2023, $4.2 billion in 2022, and $4.3 billion in 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Total operating revenue decreased by $32.9 million, or 6.2%, during our fiscal year ended September 30, 2023, compared to our fiscal year ended September 30, 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: This decrease was primarily driven by a lower volume of airframe C-checks, component contracts, rotable and expendable parts, and engine overhauls, partially offset by increases in pass-through engine overhauls and airframe C-checks.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Contract revenue increased by $44.0 million, or 10.1%, primarily due to normalized contractual rates from United and recognition of higher deferred revenue, partially offset by reduced block hours flown and partner utilization penalties compared to the twelve months ended September 30, 2021.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In prior periods, we incurred relatively low maintenance expenses on our E-175 aircraft because most of the parts are under multi-year warranties and a limited number of heavy airframe checks and engine overhauls have occurred.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: During our twelve months ended September 30, 2023, the severity of the pilot shortage, elevated pilot attrition, the transition of our operations with American to United, and increasing costs associated with pilot wages adversely impacted our financial results, cash flows, financial position, and other key financial ratios.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The decrease in operating revenues was primarily due to decreased rates and volumes in our transactional transportation-related services, which includes truckload, brokerage, and intermodal services.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase was due to the launch of new business wins and robust volumes experienced at our contract logistics operations during 2023.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: These benefits are passed on to our customers in the form of cost savings and increased operating efficiency, while enhancing our cash generation and the returns on our invested capital and assets.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Commission expense decreased due to decreased revenue in our agency-based truckload business and decreased revenue from our intermodal agents.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Other non-operating income increased by $0.5 million in 2023 and included $0.2 million in realized gain on sales of marketable securities during the year.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: On a unit basis, Passenger revenues decreased 3.7 percent, year-over-year.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: For 2023, the year-over-year Passenger revenue yield per ASM decrease was primarily driven by a 3.4 point decrease in Load factor as the capacity growth of 14.7 percent outpaced the growth in Revenue passenger miles of 10.0 percent.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: In 2023, the Company was able to focus on completing a comprehensive winter action plan, restoring its network and operational stability, reaching full utilization of its fleet, and delivering on significant new capabilities for its Customers.

records.title: FORM 10-K
records.text: For first quarter 2023, these events also created a deceleration in bookings, largely isolated to January and February 2023, as well as additional expenses primarily in the form of reimbursing Customers for costs incurred as a result of the flight cancellations.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: During fiscal year 2023, revenue generated by BCO Independent Contractors, Truck Brokerage Carriers and railroads represented approximately 38%, 53% and 2%, respectively, of the Company’s consolidated revenue.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In fiscal year 2023, the change in the number of Million Dollar Agents was attributable to agents who remained with the Company yet experienced lower year-over-year revenue that resulted in such agents moving below the Million Dollar Agent category due to the softer freight demand environment.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Approximately 43% of the Company’s consolidated revenue in fiscal year 2023 was generated under transactions that pay a fixed percentage of revenue to the third party capacity provider and/or agents while 57% was generated under transactions that pay a variable percentage of revenue to the third party capacity provider and/or agents.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Due to the increasing cost of commercial auto liability claims, the availability of excess coverage has significantly decreased, and the pricing associated with such excess coverage, to the extent available, has significantly increased.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cash provided by operating activities was $393,648,000, $622,659,000, and $276,740,000 in fiscal years 2023, 2022 and 2021, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our consolidated revenues, which totaled $4.4 billion for 2023, decreased 12.0% compared to 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our Asset-Based revenue decline reflects changes in business mix, resulting in a 2.4% decrease in tonnage per day and a 2.2% decrease in billed revenue per hundredweight, including fuel surcharges, in 2023, compared to 2022.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The revenue decline is primarily attributable to lower market rates for shipping and logistics services in a softer market environment with more available capacity, compared to the prior-year periods, despite an increase in demand for our core, published LTL business during the second half of 2023 following market disruption, as further discussed below.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The change in total billed revenue per hundredweight also reflects a decrease in fuel surcharge associated with lower fuel prices.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Consolidated operating income decreased $221.9 million in 2023, compared to 2022, primarily due to lower revenues.
